content:
Former Apple Senior Vice President of Retail Ron Johnson joins Overtime to discuss his new book, "Shop Different: How Retail Revealed Apple's Genius." Ron dives deep into the early days of the Apple Store, what it was like working with Steve Jobs, the original iPhone launch, why he decided to leave Apple to become CEO of JCPenney, his thoughts on the current state of Apple Retail, and of course his take on the "iPhone Duo."
